name: Alloy Navigator
summary: Alloy Navigator costs $19 (Explorer, up to 3 technicians), $49 (Express) or $89 (Enterprise) per technician a month on annual billing. Requesters are unlimited. Its page lists the service catalog under Enterprise only. Cloud hosting carries extra fees, and the vendor reports a SOC 2 Type II audit finished in November 2025. A trial with all features is offered.

facts.text: The pricing page lists the service catalog, ITIL processes, a CMDB and project management under Enterprise only.
The page states that cloud hosting is subject to additional fees not included in the base price, and training costs extra.
Alloy says its SOC 2 Type II audit finished in early November 2025, after a Type I report in April 2025.
The software can run on premises or in the cloud.

plans.name: Explorer
plans.notes: Billed annually, up to 3 technicians. Help desk, asset management, knowledge base and self-service portal

plans.name: Express
plans.notes: Billed annually, 4 or more technicians. Adds change management and approvals

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually, 4 or more technicians. Adds ITIL processes, CMDB, project management, service catalog

hiddenCosts: Cloud hosting carries additional fees, and the FAQ mentions a cloud setup fee.
Audit licenses for auto-discovered computers are priced separately; the calculator did not load for us.
